_comment: Generic demo case — real product cases are kept in the private Obsidian vault and passed by absolute path.

evidence: Support tickets for the widget average 40 messages per incident; 70% are the same root cause.
The three biggest customers all asked for a bulk-import fix this quarter.
A free community script already solves bulk-import for the most common file format.
The one customer running bulk-import at scale wrote its own importer and hit data-loss bugs.

decisions: Build bulk-import into the core product.
Charge for it as part of the paid tier.
counter_decisions: Leave bulk-import to the free community script.
Give bulk-import away in the free tier and charge for governance instead.

build_bulk_import.instructions: Is building bulk-import into the core product the right call?

criteria.true: The evidence supports owning this capability
criteria.false: The free script covers it well enough

criteria.paid tier: It is a reason to pay
criteria.free tier: It is table stakes, keep the paid hook elsewhere
criteria.community script: Do not build it at all
